description: This file defines a React functional component 'ChangeEditorMenu', which manages the UI and logic for changing editors or note types within an application. It includes several hooks, callback functions, and rendering logic for menu items and modal overlays.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Generates a group ID string from an EditorMenuGroup by converting the title to lowercase and replacing spaces with hyphens.

methods.name: selectComponent
methods.description: Handles selecting a new editor component for a note, updating the note's type and editor identifier, and clearing conflicts if any.

methods.name: selectNonComponent
methods.description: Handles the action of selecting a non-component note type, updating the note's type and editor identifier accordingly.

methods.name: selectItem
methods.description: Correlates to selecting a menu item, managing permissions, conflicts, and potentially triggering a super note import flow.

methods.name: handleSuperNoteConversionCompletion
methods.description: Completes the super note conversion process by updating the note and closing the importer modal.

methods.name: closeSuperNoteImporter
methods.description: Closes the super note importer modal.
